maintenance_convert_zeroed_action_desc: By checking these transactions ({count} detected), they will be converted into properly 'Skipped' occurrences (passed/paused). Their amount will be restored to its original value (shown by the → arrow). This allows your recurrence to stay active and keep generating the following months at their normal amount.
maintenance_convert_zeroed_desc_1: Previously, to temporarily pause a subscription or recurrence (e.g. Audible paused for 3 months), the only solution was to manually set the occurrence amount to 0.00 €.
maintenance_convert_zeroed_desc_2: However, these 0 € amounts mislead the maintenance algorithms into believing the recurrence has been permanently closed or abandoned, triggering auto-closures or false orphan detections.
maintenance_convert_zeroed_none: No transactions to convert. Everything is in order!

maintenance_orphan_none: No orphan recurrences detected. Everything is in order!
